title: Security Eng Sync Notes - 2026-03-02
content:
Weekly Security Engineering Sync - 2026-03-02
Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Arjun Patel, Leah Ortiz, Tomás Rivera, Priya Singh (on-call)
Duration: 45m
Location: Zoom / #security-sync

Agenda:
- Quick triage: incoming vuln reports (deps & infra)
- Secrets management / scan gaps
- Threat modeling kickoff for Releases API changes
- Action items & owners

Notes (raw):
- Vulnerability triage
  - JIRA-3421: high severity vuln reported in fastjson-2.x via OSS report. Affects some internal ingestion workers that still use the old parsing path.
    - Decision: immediate mitigation = pin to 2.1.3 and add runtime WAF rule to block suspicious payloads. Medium-term: plan dependency upgrade to 3.x in dedicated branch; target in sprint 13.
    - Owner: Arjun (mitigation) due 2026-03-04; Leah (upgrade plan) due 2026-03-16.
  - JIRA-3478: medium vuln in metrics-exporter (exposed Prom endpoint with unauth rate-limit bypass). Currently only in staging; need to check Dedicated clusters.
    - Action: add auth proxy + rate-limit in prod-like envs; Tomás to validate Dedicated pool configs.
    - Owner: Tomás due 2026-03-06.
  - Notes: confirm which customer Dedicated clusters run the old exporter image; may need emergency rotation for those customers. Priya to check on-call logs and reach out to SE for known customers.

- Secrets detection & rotation
  - Recent GitHub leak (partial API key surfaced in a test script) flagged by TruffleHog but not rotated immediately. Root cause: scan alert routed to wrong Slack channel and missed by on-call.
  - Immediate actions: rotate leaked key (done by Maya during meeting), add an automated runbook so scan->pagerflow->on-call is explicit.
  - Gaps identified:
    - Our scanner excludes dotfiles in some repos; repo: infra/ci-scripts had creds in .env.example (policy gap).
    - No enforced pre-commit hook for secret scanning on private repos that contain deployment manifests.
  - Remediations:
    - Add org-level pre-commit check for all infra repos (Leah) due 2026-03-09.
    - Update internal docs and create a Confluence runbook: CONFLUENCE-SEC-774 (Maya) due 2026-03-05.
    - Short-term: add a GitHub Actions job to block merges with high-confidence secret findings (Tomás) due 2026-03-08.

- Threat modeling: Releases API changes (moving to new rollout svc)
  - Goal: model new inter-service call paths, auth boundaries, and data flows for rollout metadata + prompt templates.
  - Open questions:
    - Should template storage keep customer-specific encryption at rest keys (KMS) or use centralized RW key per cluster? Tradeoffs: key management complexity vs. customer isolation.
    - Impact on latency if we introduce async validation—needs perf SLO alignment with product.
  - Next steps:
    - Host a 60m threat-modeling session with product & infra: proposed 2026-03-09 10:00-11:00. Maya to schedule and add invite.
    - Prework: high-level data flow diagram from engineering (Arjun) by 2026-03-06.
    - Deliverable: threat model doc in Confluence + a short action list (authorization fixes, encryption decisions).

- Observability & alerting
  - We need a dedicated alert for abandoned secrets scan alerts (i.e., alert created but unresolved after 24h). Might be a PagerDuty schedule problem.
  - Action: Leah to propose an alert rule and PD escalation path (due 2026-03-10).

Decisions made this meeting:
- Pin fastjson to 2.1.3 + WAF rule as immediate mitigation (Arjun).
- Rotate leaked key and create runbook (Maya & Leah).

Action items recap:
- Arjun: Implement fastjson pin + WAF rule on ingestion workers; validate; due 2026-03-04. (JIRA-3421)
- Leah: Draft upgrade plan for fastjson->3.x (sprint 13), propose pre-commit checks org-wide; due 2026-03-16 and 2026-03-09 respectively.
- Tomás: Add GitHub Actions job to block merges with high-confidence secret findings; validate Dedicated pool exporter auth; due 2026-03-08 and 2026-03-06.
- Priya: Check on-call logs for Dedicated clusters running old exporter images; escalate if match; due 2026-03-03.
- Maya: Create Confluence runbook (CONFLUENCE-SEC-774) for secret incident flow; schedule threat-modeling session; due 2026-03-05 and 2026-03-04.
- Leah: Propose alert for unresolved secret scan alerts + PD escalation; due 2026-03-10.

Parking lot / unresolved:
- Do we require customer-specific KMS per template store? Need legal/product input for compliance customers. Add to threat modeling session agenda.
- Inventory check: which Dedicated customers run legacy ingestion workers? Might need patching window requests.
- Follow-up: automated validation of image manifests to detect outdated exporters (owner: infra team).

Notes to self / informal:
- Reminder: add a note in sprint board to correlate JIRA-3421 with the security release cycle.
- Quick test: run local trufflehog on infra/ci-scripts after lunch.

Next meeting: 2026-03-09 (threat modeling deep-dive).

End of notes.
